description: An inventory built with SvGrid Base, a table database component for Svelte 5: an Items table and a Suppliers table as tabs, linked both ways. Items have photos, a category, a location, a supplier, quantity, unit cost and a stock value formula; each supplier lists its items and units in stock. Views for stock grouped by category, a photo gallery, items by location, a reorder list and an add-item form.

faq.question: Is this a template or a component?
faq.answer: A component: <SvBase> with your rows and columns. Most of the demo is sample data; the views, the field editor, the record view and the form come with the component.

faq.question: How is the stock value computed?
faq.answer: Stock value is a formula field, {Qty} * {Unit cost}, shown as currency. It is parsed once into functions, never evaluated as code, and its footer sums the column.

faq.question: How does the Reorder view work?
faq.answer: A saved filter keeps items with three or fewer in stock, sorted by quantity, and condition colors mark them: red at zero, amber at three or fewer.

faq.question: Which license does it need?
faq.answer: SvGrid Base is part of the Suite edition of @svgrid/enterprise. Without a key it runs with a watermark, so it can be evaluated as is.
